speech.heard: One big country breaks this pattern. It is not the one you'd guess. Djibouti, 92.2 percent. The world's highest share of employment in the service sector. Look at these three giants, the USA, Brazil and India. India is the outlier. India, 32.6 percent. Djibouti has 2.8 times the service employment India has. UK, 83.2. USA, 79.6. Brazil, 72.2. Burundi, 11.6%. The world's lowest share, where few people work in transport or finance. This counts working age people engaged in any activity to provide services for pay. What kind of services keep your city running?
